title: Opti Pepo Mobile
description: A optimized modpack for playing in Zalith launcher
body:
Opti Pepo Mobile is a performance-focused modpack designed specifically for Zalith Launcher and other Android-based Minecraft emulators. Built for Minecraft 1.21.8 (Fabric), this modpack is optimized to run as smoothly as possible on mobile hardware.

⚡ Designed for Mobile
Unlike most modpacks made for desktop PCs, Opti Pepo Mobile was built from the ground up with mobile performance in mind. Every mod was carefully selected and configured to reduce CPU usage, lower memory consumption, and maximize FPS on limited hardware.

🔧 Recommended Setup
For the best experience, use this modpack with the MobileGLues renderer inside Zalith Launcher. MobileGLues provides Vulkan-based rendering that is significantly more stable and performant on modern Android devices compared to older renderers like GL4ES.

📦 What's Included
A curated selection of the best optimization mods available for Fabric 1.21.8, including Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, Entity Culling, More Culling, ImmediatelyFast, and more — all pre-configured so you can just download and play.

✅ No Setup Required
All video settings are pre-configured for optimal mobile performance. Just install, launch, and enjoy a smoother Minecraft experience on your Android device.
